sources.role: directory defaults, state/playback options, inipath per OS
pinned MAME 0.280 controller-contract source (docs/source/advanced/ctrlr_config.rst); cfg/machine facts re-verified on current master

paths.path: mame.ini in the MAME folder via `mame -createconfig` (distro builds run it from the terminal); inipath default is "$HOME/.mame;.;ini", and layering adds source/<sourcefile>.ini, BIOS/parent and per-system <shortname>.ini; ui.ini/plugin.ini are written by -createconfig. Per-game input/config: cfg/default.cfg (global input defaults) and cfg/<shortname>.cfg (per-machine) as <mameconfig version="10"> XML holding mapper-written input sequences (KEYCODE_*/JOYCODE_* tokens, STARTn/COINn etc.). Controller presets: ctrlrpath default "ctrlr"; MAME ships sample files there and -ctrlr <name> loads <name>.cfg with <mapdevice> stable-ID elements and default/parent/BIOS/source-file <system> sections
paths.naming: Controller syntax is MAME v10 XML in cfg/default.cfg and cfg/<shortname>.cfg (`KEYCODE_*`/`JOYCODE_*` sequences); optional ctrlr/<name>.cfg profiles use <mapdevice> stable IDs
evidence: docs:multiconfig (ini layering, saves to first inipath entry)
docs:commandline-all (inipath "$HOME/.mame;.;ini", cfg_directory default cfg, ctrlrpath default ctrlr)
source:mamedev/mame src/emu/config.cpp (loads default.cfg as DEFAULT and basename()+".cfg" as SYSTEM from cfg_directory; controller file "<ctrlr>.cfg")
source:mamedev/mame src/frontend/mame/clifront.cpp (-createconfig writes mame.ini, ui.ini, plugin.ini)
contract: docs/MAME_STANDALONE_PROGRESS.md (owned default.cfg and machine-basename cfg copies matching pinned config.cpp load order)

contract: docs/MAME_CONTROLLER_CONTRACT.md (version-10 controller XML writer; inspection launch routes cfg, ctrlr, ROMs, NVRAM, diff, states, snapshots and input recordings into a private tree with INI load/write disabled)

paths.path: nvram/ (nvram_directory default "nvram"), inp/ recordings and snap/ snapshots (plus diff/ for disk images)
paths.naming: Per-game NVRAM .nv files named by machine short name in nvram/ (non-default BIOS adds _N; device NVRAM lands in <set>/<software>/<device_tag> subpaths with ':' replaced by '_'); input recordings via -record/-playback open files in inp/ (docs: keep .cfg/.nv and memory-card files identical or delete them to avoid desync); snapshots use snapname default %g/%i, i.e. snap/<shortname>/NNNN.png per system
evidence: source:mamedev/mame docs/man/mame.6 (input_directory default 'inp' beside the MAME executable, auto-created; .cfg/.nv advice)
source:mamedev/mame src/emu/machine.cpp (nvram_save opens nvram_filename in nvram_directory: basename, _biosN suffix, device subfolders)
source:mamedev/mame src/emu/ioport.cpp (record/playback files opened in input_directory)

paths.naming: Verified: statename default %g yields sta/<shortname>/<slot>.sta (compose_saveload_filename appends PATH_SEPARATOR and ".sta" to the slot name); -autosave uses slot "auto" (sta/<shortname>/auto.sta), quick saves use numbered slots; -state <slot> loads immediately at start
evidence: docs:commandline-all (state_directory default sta, statename default %g creating a per-system folder, -state/-autosave)

paths.path: roms/ (rompath default "roms") keyed by MAME machine set names and hash metadata in hash/*.xml (hashpath default "hash"); device ROMs are ordinary MAME ROM sets, not per-game BIOS folders
paths.naming: MAME ROM-set naming: <machine short name> archives/files plus hash/*.xml manifests; exact BIOS/device filenames and hashes come from the per-set XML or firmware rule, not a universal BIOS name
evidence: docs:commandline-all (rompath default roms, hashpath default hash)

db:firmware_rules mame entries (sources/firmware-rules.json: runtime_kind mame, target_strategy mame_rompath, e.g. neogeo/casloopy/coco romsets plus github:mame-hash-files XMLs with target_subdir @hash)
lunchbox:crates/lunchbox-app/src/firmware.rs (mame runtime root ~/.mame/roms; '@hash' installs to sibling hash/ of the rompath root)

linux.notes: Lunchbox standalone-MAME launch uses explicit -cfg_directory/-ctrlrpath routing with private default.cfg, <shortname>.cfg and controller-profile copies; originals are never written and runtime cfg changes stay session-local (docs/MAME_STANDALONE_PROGRESS.md). The libretro-core contract (docs/MAME_CONTROLLER_CONTRACT.md) instead routes cfg, ctrlr, ROMs, NVRAM, diff, states, snapshots and input recordings into a private tree and disables INI loading/writing.

paths.path: org.mamedev.MAME: the manifest persists $HOME/.mame (--persist=.mame) and the bundled mame.ini pins cfg/nvram/inp/sta/snap/diff/comments/share under $HOME/.mame/ inside the sandbox; inipath is "$HOME/.mame;/app/share/mame/ini" so a user mame.ini (from -createconfig) lives in the persisted .mame/ while read-only defaults stay under /app/share/mame; ctrlr presets resolve from ctrlrpath /app/share/mame/ctrlr unless overridden in the user mame.ini
paths.naming: Controller syntax is the same MAME v10 XML as native: cfg/default.cfg and cfg/<shortname>.cfg hold KEYCODE_*/JOYCODE_* sequences; ctrlr/<name>.cfg profiles use <mapdevice> stable IDs
evidence: flathub:org.mamedev.MAME README.md (--persist=.mame is the writable location for cfg, diff, nvram, etc.)

paths.path: nvram/, inp/ and snap/ under the persisted $HOME/.mame/ (host-side under ~/.var/app/org.mamedev.MAME/); diff/ and comments/ share the same root
paths.naming: Identical to native: nvram/<shortname>.nv per game (plus _N BIOS suffix and device subpaths), -record/-playback files in inp/, snapshots snap/<shortname>/NNNN.png
Same as native: sta/<shortname>/<slot>.sta with statename default %g; autosave uses slot "auto"

paths.path: bundled rompath is /app/share/mame/roms (read-only /app); hashpath /app/share/mame/hash. Lunchbox installs MAME firmware into the per-app data root ~/.var/app/org.mamedev.MAME/data/mame/roms and appends that directory to -rompath at launch; the manifest also grants --filesystem=host:ro for external roms/samples
paths.naming: MAME ROM-set naming: <machine short name> archives/files plus hash/*.xml manifests; exact BIOS/device filenames and hashes come from the per-set XML or firmware rule, not a universal BIOS name
evidence: flathub:org.mamedev.MAME README.md (--filesystem=host:ro for external data, roms, samples)
lunchbox:crates/lunchbox-app/src/emulator.rs (mame_runtime_roms_directory appends the flatpak roms dir to -rompath)

linux-flatpak.notes: The Flatpak keeps every writable MAME folder inside the persisted $HOME/.mame sandbox tree; the lunchbox probes have launched this Flatpak with an exact collection/runtime -rompath list (docs/FRONTEND_ARCHITECTURE.md arcade-launch-probe).
